Crystal Gemstone Collection
Mixed Mineral Specimen Lot - 12 Pieces
Natural Stones, Various Finishes
This collection of twelve natural stones and crystals features a variety of mineral specimens in raw, tumbled, and carved forms. The set includes representative examples of popular gemstones for display or study. Each piece showcases unique geological characteristics, from the bladed structure of kyanite to the botryoidal formations of grape agate.
12 distinct specimens including Blue Kyanite, Grape Agate, and Clear Quartz
Mix of raw clusters, tumbled stones, a polished sphere, and a stone pyramid
Varieties include Amethyst, Red Jasper, Unakite, Fluorite, and Banded Agate

Polished tumbled stones, the sphere, and the pyramid feature smooth, glossy surfaces with minimal surface wear. No significant fractures or damage beyond natural geological inclusions and color variations inherent to the mineral materials.
